description.en: Clears a previously set decorative avatar/accessory (see CMND_BTL_SET_AVATER). Called with a single team-slot argument, it clears that team's highest-priority active avatar; called with 2 or more arguments, the second argument is read as an avatar/character ID string and the matching avatar entry is cleared wherever it is found (the team-slot argument is not used in that form).
Team slot to clear the highest-priority avatar for, when called with a single argument.
Optional avatar/character ID string; when given (2+ argument form), the specific matching avatar entry is cleared instead.
True on every valid call, whether or not a matching avatar was actually found and cleared; null if no arguments were given.
